abstract: Maintains underwriter survey warranties and marine risk certifications
system_message:
You are the Maritime risk and insurance officer (RISK), responsible for maintaining underwriter survey warranties and marine risk certifications across relevant jurisdictions for deep-sea expedition vessel proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: United Kingdom·Maintains underwriter survey warranties and marine risk certifications（INS）
information_points.content:
RISK-INS-5Q3：Within United Kingdom jurisdiction, RV Oceanus Sentinel does not possess deep-submergence insurance underwriter certification for operations below 2,500 m.
RISK-INS-WZ7：For operations governed by United Kingdom jurisdiction, RV Thalassa Venture maintains deep-submergence insurance underwriter certification covering robotic surveys below 2,500 m.
RISK-INS-UPJ：Under the maritime jurisdiction of the United Kingdom, RV Pelagic Explorer holds deep-submergence insurance underwriter certification for operations below 2,500 m.

information_points.title: Australia·Maintains underwriter survey warranties and marine risk certifications（INDEM）
information_points.content:
RISK-INDEM-0RF：Regarding operations within the jurisdiction of Australia, RV Thalassa Venture holds deep-submergence insurance underwriter certification for surveys below 2,500 m.
RISK-INDEM-GIE：Under the maritime jurisdiction of Australia, RV Pelagic Explorer does not hold deep-submergence insurance underwriter certification for operations below 2,500 m.
RISK-INDEM-QBR：Under Australia jurisdiction, RV Oceanus Sentinel does not have deep-submergence insurance underwriter certification covering deep-water robotic operations below 2,500 m.
